prompts.title: Mapa e paletas
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: polished product concept screenshot for the future Global Empires scenario editor, a Windows RTS creation tool spanning 1850 to today. Generate ONE flat full-screen desktop application screenshot, wide landscape 16:9. Extremely crisp, readable Portuguese UI, disciplined alignment, clean professional creation software, not a game HUD and not an illustrated poster. Shared design system: charcoal and deep forest-green panels, warm ivory typography, restrained antique-gold active accents, teal selection outlines, thin subtle separators, compact clear sans-serif text, square softly rounded controls. Historical identity through restrained color and a tiny globe emblem only. No baroque borders, parchment, gratuitous gradients, fantasy weapons, medieval castle, cyberpunk neon, device mockup, perspective skew or giant marketing title. Include the top application title 'GLOBAL EMPIRES · EDITOR', menus 'Arquivo  Editar  Exibir  Cenário  Ferramentas  Ajuda', workspace tabs 'Mapa  Objetos  Lógica  IA  Campanha', a search field 'Buscar…  Ctrl K', and right-side buttons 'Validar' and 'Testar ▶'. Make UI text purposeful and sufficiently large. Footer clearly says 'CONCEITO • dados ilustrativos'. This is a proposed design, never label it implemented or validated software.
SCREEN 01 — MAPA. Active workspace Mapa. A single coherent app screenshot. Left dock occupies about 18% width, a calm central 3D map viewport occupies 60%, right context inspector 22%; low compact asset shelf along the bottom. Top breadcrumb 'Travessia do Interior / cenário'. Left dock contains hierarchy 'Cenário', 'Terreno', 'Unidades', 'Doodads', 'Regiões', 'Câmeras', with small visibility/lock icons. Beneath, tool palette tabs labeled 'Terreno', 'Unidades', 'Doodads', 'Regiões', 'Câmeras', and terrain tools 'Pintar', 'Elevar', 'Suavizar', 'Nivelar'. Center: attractive stylized low-poly isometric Brazilian rural industrial RTS landscape, vivid green rolling fields, terracotta-roofed farm buildings, a small river crossing and wooden bridge, dirt roads, distant hills, a few 19th-century riflemen, fence lines and trees. This is a scene viewport without in-game resource bars or unit portraits. A soft terrain brush circle is projected on a riverbank and a subtle square grid appears only near it. Bottom viewport overlay toggles 'Navegação', 'Visão', 'Cobertura', 'Logística'. Right inspector titled 'Pincel de terreno', fields 'Material: Terra batida', 'Raio  12 m', 'Intensidade  35%', sliders, and a clear toggle 'Apenas aparência' with the secondary choice 'Terreno de jogo'; this distinction describes authoring targets, not new gameplay rules. Under it a compact minimap. Asset shelf shows thumbnail cards for grass, earth, rock, shallow water and embankment. Include one small readable right-click menu floating near the viewport upper-right, items 'Criar região aqui', 'Capturar câmera', 'Adicionar ponto', 'Propriedades'. Bottom bar has 'Desfazer', a short history entry 'Pintura de terreno', and 'Projeto salvo'. Prioritize the beautiful map and usable panel structure, keep interfaces calm.
